title: Average age of mobilized recruits joining Ukraine’s Air Assault forces is 35–44
summary: The average age of mobilized personnel joining the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces is currently 35–44.

title: Ukraine’s Air Assault Forces adapt Western combat tactics and training methods to battlefield needs
summary: The training of servicemen in the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces incorporates practices adopted from partner countries, particularly tactics for combat in urban and wooded areas and methods of instruction.

title: Another stage of search operations completed in Puzhnyky, no mass grave found
summary: A team of Ukrainian and Polish specialists has completed another stage of searches for the remains of people killed during World War II in the former village of Puzhnyky in the Ternopil region.
